en_title: Rockstar Says Darts Were Cut From GTA 6 Because It Didn't Have 'Unlimited Money or Time' to Make It 'Feel Proper'
cn_title: Rockstar称《GTA 6》删掉飞镖是因为没有「无限的资金或时间」让它「感觉到位」
opus_summary: Rockstar North联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson表示，《GTA6》删去了飞镖等小游戏，因为团队没有无限的资金和时间来达到所需品质。团队从《荒野大镖客：救赎2》开始更重视小游戏的真实感，台球得以完整实现，飞镖则未能完成。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games crammed a lot of content into GTA 6 , but fan-favorite mini-games like darts and bowling didn't make the cut because the team didn't have "unlimited money or unlimited time" to do those activities justice.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar在《GTA 6》中塞入了大量内容，但飞镖和保龄球等深受粉丝喜爱的小游戏未能入选，因为团队没有「无限的资金或无限的时间」把这些活动做好。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson explained why the studio chose to focus on some aspects of development and not others during an interview with VGC . As noted by the site, picking up a game of darts has proven to be a good pastime in games like GTA 5 and GTA Online, but in GTA 6, the standards were a bit higher.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar North联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson在接受VGC采访时解释了工作室为何选择专注于开发的某些方面，而非其他方面。正如该网站所指出的，在《GTA 5》和《GTA Online》等游戏中玩一局飞镖已被证明是一种不错的消遣，但在《GTA 6》中，标准要稍高一些。

paragraphs.en: From NPCs to the feel of motorized scooters, Leonida is Rockstar's most realistic playground yet. Every blade of grass was given special attention, and while pool was one game the team was able to fully realize, not everything panned out like they had hoped. Nelson said "darts was a contentious one" when talking about the decision to cut it from the game, explaining that it was left behind because the team didn't have the resources to do it right.
paragraphs.cn: 从NPC到电动踏板车的手感，Leonida是Rockstar迄今为止最逼真的游乐场。每一片草叶都受到了特别关注，虽然台球是团队得以完整实现的一项游戏，但并非所有事情都如他们所愿。谈到从游戏中删掉飞镖的决定时，Nelson表示「飞镖是一个有争议的项目」，并解释说，它被舍弃是因为团队没有资源把它做好。

paragraphs.en: "Even we… you hear they have unlimited money or unlimited time, even we do not and so sometimes you just have to admit we are not going to be able to make this to the level we feel we need to," he said.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「即使是我们……你会听到人们说他们有无限的资金或无限的时间，连我们也没有，所以有时候你只能承认，我们没办法把这个做到我们认为需要达到的水平。」

paragraphs.en: Nelson elaborated, saying that, starting with Red Dead Redemption 2, the team started to treat mini-games more like activities. In other words, bonuses like darts became less about being a diversion of Rockstar's open worlds and more of an extension of them. The goal is to make pool, darts, or any other activity feel like it's just as punchy and weighty for Jason and Lucia as it is in the real world.
paragraphs.cn: Nelson进一步解释说，从《荒野大镖客：救赎2》开始，团队开始将小游戏更多地视为活动。换言之，飞镖之类的额外内容不再仅仅是Rockstar开放世界中的消遣，而更多地成为其延伸。目标是让台球、飞镖或其他任何活动对Jason和Lucia而言，都能像在现实世界中一样给人有力且有分量的感觉。

paragraphs.en: Using GTA 6's in-game workouts as an example, he added, "You’re not just pushing a button; it mimics what weightlifting is."
paragraphs.cn: 他以《GTA 6》中的健身活动为例补充道：「你不只是在按一个按钮；它模拟了举重的实际体验。」

paragraphs.en: "A lot of work [is needed] to get it tuned right," Nelson continued. "Darts is one we just didn’t get to."
paragraphs.cn: Nelson继续说道：「要把它调整到位需要做大量工作。飞镖就是我们没能来得及做的一个项目。」

paragraphs.en: Long story short, Rockstar just "didn't have the resources" to make it "feel proper." His thoughts on the matter – or any scenario where a mechanic or activity is cut – were summed up in one line: "It’s better not to do it than to do it and have it not be good enough."
paragraphs.cn: 长话短说，Rockstar只是「没有资源」让它「感觉到位」。他对这件事——或任何机制或活动被删减的情况——的看法可以归结为一句话：「与其做出来却不够好，不如不做。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is now the highest-rated game of all time . IGN gave it a 10/10 review .
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》现在是有史以来评分最高的游戏。IGN给它打出了10/10分。

paragraphs.en: For one of the better examples of the care the developers put into side activities, look no further than some of the games Jason has on his JoySystem . You can see how Rockstar pulled from real-world inspirations to create his character here .
paragraphs.cn: 想要了解开发者对支线活动倾注了多少心血，一个较好的例子就是Jason的JoySystem上拥有的一些游戏。你可以在这里了解Rockstar如何从现实世界中汲取灵感来塑造这个角色。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或是不知道接下来该做什么？来IGN查看《GTA 6》官方指南吧。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《GTA》的新系统，或通过第一章指南与提示和第二章指南与提示了解前几章的所有详情。如果你已经开车走遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和做的事情，请查看Leonida互动地图。
